title: genista tinctoria var. humilior
intro: Genista tinctoria var. humilior, commonly known as the small broom or dwarf dyer's greenweed, is a plant species within the legume family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Genista tinctoria var. humilior include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
